applicabilityBasis.summary: Open USD is a U.S.-issued, dollar-pegged payment stablecoin issued by Bridge Building Inc. for payments, settlement and treasury use. Open Standard's launch disclosure specifies 1:1 USD mint and burn; Bridge's binding stablecoin terms provide redemption for one U.S. dollar, subject to user eligibility and compliance conditions.

genius.licensingRegulator: FinCEN MSB registration and applicable state money transmitter regulators for Bridge Building Inc. (NMLS #2450917). OCC preliminary conditional approval applies to the separate Bridge National Trust Bank in organization, not the current OUSD issuer.
genius.notes: Authorization posture reviewed 2026-10-07 and not renewed here: Bridge's token-specific OUSD overview names the GENIUS Act, supporting issuer-announced intent rather than statutory compliance or official authorization. Bridge Building Inc. remains the named current issuer; the separate Bridge National Trust Bank in organization and its preliminary conditional charter approval do not establish current OUSD prudential supervision or PPSI approval. Issuer pathway stays unknown. Binding BBI terms provide eligible-user redemption subject to onboarding, compliance and processing conditions. Disclosure-only correction retrieved 2026-10-20: the dashboard now links an EY independent examination of the August 31 OUSD reserves and whole redeemable supply, signed October 1, with all four exact native deployments. The original no-report finding is superseded, and monthlyAttestationPresent records this published report plus the issuer's monthly-report commitment. Canonical report dates are authored only in proofOfReserves.latestReport; no current holdings or authorization claim is inferred from the report. DASP posture remains the prior pre-effective finding, and no enforcement-history or primary-regulator assignment is added.
